newsitem.title: UK: No suntans for swans, British ballet dancers told.
newsitem.headline: No suntans for swans, British ballet dancers told.

text.p: A British ballet troupe have been told to lose their suntans because their bosses fear they will look more like lobsters than swans for a forthcoming production of "Swan Lake."
The order went out as the English National Ballet reassembled after a five-week holiday break sporting sun-kissed bodies ranging from pink to deep brown.
Dancers in "Swan Lake" are supposed to be pale and white and even heavy stage make-up cannot disguise a deep tan, a spokesman for the company told BBC radio on Tuesday.
"We simply cannot have roasted swans," artistic director Derek Deane told the dancers, asking them to stay indoors or wear hats and sunblock outside.
